skills.name: Quantum Shift
skills.description: Kỹ năng hiện tại trên Wiki ở Rank 2; bản dịch tác dụng đang cập nhật. Xem phần đối chiếu để đọc cơ chế gốc.
skills.officialDescription: Distort the timeline to alter combat capabilities. Applies Quantum Shift to you and your allies, increasing Crit Chance and Defense by 30% as well as Outgoing Physical and Outgoing Magical Damage by 10% for 10 seconds.
wikiNotes: At Rank 10, Quantum Shift applies stacks of Quantum Spiral to you for each friendly target affected, increasing your Crit Modifier and DoT damage by 10% for 23 seconds, stacks to 40 but cannot be refreshed.
skills.target: An infinite range status skill that applies to 20 friendly targets.
skills.rangeSourceText: An infinite range status skill that applies to 20 friendly targets.

effectEvidence.description: Distort the timeline to alter combat capabilities. Applies Quantum Shift to you and your allies, increasing Crit Chance and Defense by 30% as well as Outgoing Physical and Outgoing Magical Damage by 10% for 10 seconds.
notes: At Rank 10, Quantum Shift applies stacks of Quantum Spiral to you for each friendly target affected, increasing your Crit Modifier and DoT damage by 10% for 23 seconds, stacks to 40 but cannot be refreshed.
effectEvidence.translationMethod: Source-bound V12.11 reviewed translation; original Wiki evidence retained

recoveryReview.rationale: The current active Wiki note and official detailed mechanic both state 23 seconds and non-refreshing expiry. The passive description says 20 seconds. No duration change found in the archived/current balance lists; use corroborated 23 seconds for both effect views, retaining the contradictory raw source. Confidence: medium.
recoveryReview.excerpt: Quantum Spiral: 10% for 23 seconds, stacks to 40 but cannot be refreshed; lose all stacks after 23 seconds.

effects.name: Quantum Shift
effects.text: Tăng 30% Crit Chance và Defense, tăng 10% sát thương vật lý và phép gây ra trong 10 giây.
Ở Rank 10: Mỗi mục tiêu đồng minh chịu tác động của Quantum Shift cho một stack Quantum Spiral: tăng 10% hệ số Crit và sát thương DoT mỗi stack trong 23 giây, tối đa 40 stack; không làm mới thời hạn.

skills.name: Quantum Restructure
skills.description: Kỹ năng hiện tại trên Wiki ở Rank 3; bản dịch tác dụng đang cập nhật. Xem phần đối chiếu để đọc cơ chế gốc.
skills.officialDescription: Hack into reality for a brief moment and rebuild it in your favor. Applies Quantum Restructure to significantly reduce the amount of damage you take, while inflicting Quantum Rupture to significantly increase the amount of damage your target takes. Both effects last 2 seconds. Never misses or crits.
wikiNotes: Quantum Restructure increases the player's Dodge by 80% and decreases DoT In, All In, Phys In and Mag In by 20% for 2 seconds.
Quantum Rupture decreases the enemy's Dodge by 80% and increases DoT In, All In, Phys In and Mag In by 20% for 2 seconds.
